notes.title: 0.4.2 Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Adjusted item spawn rate. There should be much more loot in earlier dungeons now
[*] Hungry! - Goblins now start out as Hungry, having 85 maximum stamina. If you eat something, you get your stamina up to 100 again plus the bonus from the food itself! 
[*] “Depth -1F” now has an additional place to travel to
[*] Made Bucket Upgrade shop sign a bit clearer. Looks less like a medbay now.
[*] Added a sign for the Pawn Shop (where you sell stuff)
[*] Durability on some weapons have been adjusted
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed lobby unlock area not being accessible if a player joins after it is unlocked
[*] Fixed rendering issues in Prison
[*] Fixed various graphical issues in dungeons
[*] Fixed bucket upgrades not being removed properly after game over
[*] Fixed issue causing items to break if two players pick it up at the same time
[*] Fixed issue your arms would animate in a running animation when holding items
[*] Fixed chat not properly showing when a player joins or leaves the game
[*] Fixed Blast Potion not triggering its effect when thrown at an enemy
[*] Fixed a bug where the Rewards Chest during gambling could get stuct in its animation
[*] Fixed chat sending message when pressing ESC during typing
[*] Fixed changing items with keyboard while typing in the chat
[*] Adjusted skeleton walking animation speed. Now it should look better and less running in place.
[*] Various AI behaviour fixes
[/list]
… And other small fixes here and there!

notes.title: Exploration update 0.3.0
notes.content:
[h2]Randomized dungeons!!! [/h2]

[h3][i]Every delve is now even more different than before[/i][/h3]

[i]The first iteration of randomized dungeons are now finally in the game!! We've been hard at work designing and building a solid foundation for dungeon randomization that we believe will add a lot to the Pit of Goblin experience by making every delve even more unique than before!

It is still in an early phase but we hope to keep iterating on the randomization based on your feedback and fix any new bugs that may have surfaced. Still, we hope you enjoy exploring these new unique dungeons as much as we have! 

Additionally, more content such as new enemies and items are being worked on and will be added as soon as they are ready! Please look forward to it!

/ David, Kristian, Krab & Johan[/i]

[h3]Dungeons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dungeon Randomization(!!!)
[*] New Secret rooms added
[*] New Looting rooms and areas added to existing dungeons
[*] Bonfires and wall torches are now dynamically placed in the dungeons. Some dungeons may be darker and lighting your own way matters more than ever!
[*] Depth 3 now contains bigger and deadlier versions of previous dungeons (But of course, with more loot!)
[/list]
[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Item: Short Torch
[*] Long Torches now burn out faster
[*] Amount of times you can leave bread crumbs with bread has been increased
[/list]
[h3]Improvements and Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] New rendering optimizations
[*] Network bandwidth optimizations
[*] Inventory and Item refactor, offering more stability
[*] There was an edge case where the player could cause items to disappear from the bucket, this has been fixed
[*] More intuitive fire, updated rules for what you can light your torch on. Feel free to light your torch on your friend's torch equipped on their back! 
[*] Correctly waits for animation to play before using items (such as eating food, using torch, putting on equipment )
[*] Torch no longer stuck in pointing state when pointing the torch and switching to another inventory slot
[*] Torch no longer stuck in pointing state when dropping the torch while pointing with it
[*] Lit torch correctly placed on back when picking up a big item.
[*] Improvements to pressure plate detection and network sync for all traps
[*] Various AI improvements and fixes to support dungeon randomization
[*] Fixed many issues with AI sometimes getting stuck in collision
[/list]

notes.title: Pit of Goblin in 2025: The Road to Release
notes.content:
[h2]Pit of Goblin in 2025: The Road to Release[/h2]

It’s been just over a month since Pit of Goblin made released into Early Access, and we couldn’t be more thrilled with the journey so far. Over the holidays, we dropped a small winter content update to keep the festivities alive in the Pit, and we also took some much-needed time to recharge.

We’ve been back at work for a little while and wanted to share some updates with you! If you caught our Early Access roadmap, you already know we’ve got big plans, and the first content patch is just around the corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271762/6244b15c04a89807becb0adfe3f9b705a3e7fe86.png[/img]

[b]The Exploration Update[/b] is all about [i]Level Randomization[/i]! – A much requested feature, finally coming your way! Each dive into the Pit will be that little bit different adding to the challenge and excitement!

In addition to this patch we are also working on -
[list]
[*] Smarter, Trickier AI – Those nasties down in the Pit are going to behave a little different moving forward.
[*] Optimizations & Polished Gameplay – Making the Pit smoother than ever.
[/list]

Once the Exploration Update is live and solid, we’ll roll up our sleeves for the next big milestone: the [b]Goblin Mode Update[/b]. Trust us, you won’t want to miss what’s coming next.
Your support and feedback have been incredible and are what make this game so special. We’re building 
Pit of Goblin with the community, for the community, so keep those ideas and suggestions coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271762/a6c9a7b820bbbdf182dd24129816f9440914b371.png[/img]

If you want to leave feedback and suggestions, the discussion forums or our Discord is the best place to do that.

Thank you, as always, for your enthusiasm. We’ll see you back in the Pit soon. Get ready for what’s next!

notes.title: Pit of Goblin Early Access is here! 🎮
notes.content:
The day has finally arrived! We've been hard at work and have plenty of exciting new updates, fixes, and surprises to share with you. All for your enjoyment. Read on... if you dare!

[h3][b]Menu[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Menu in 3 Dimensions!!!
[*] Keybind Support - Finally, change keys to your liking!
[*] Score Screen - Now after successfully feeding the King Queen you’ll see how well you did. Or if you fail, how well you didn’t!
[*] Localization to a bunch of languages!
[list]
[*] English
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Russian
[*] Swedish
[/list]
[h3][b]Online[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Join Random Games - Now you are able to join random games! Meet new goblins from other tribes! Just be nice to each other or I’ll be very cross with you.
[*] Game State now restarts properly upon Game Over, allowing players to start anew without having to host a new game.
[*] You can now join your friends through steam by using the friends list
[/list]
[h3][b]Character Customization[/b][/h3]
Players are now able to customize their goblin even further! Change hairstyle, hair color and more!

[h3][b]Player Animation Overhaul[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The player goblins have received a new system containing many new dynamic animations using IK. 
[*] Other players can now see you interact with the torch, readying for a throw, switching items, holding different types of objects and more!
[/list]
[h3][b]Optimization[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Big overhaul where the game is now being rendered at a lower resolution instead of shader pixelation, improving performance drastically on many computers! Less intense for those graphics cards.
[*] Lights in the lobby are no longer as performance intensive as earlier.
[*] Network traffic optimization resulting in much less rubberbanding and desync of player positions, especially during higher latency.
[/list]
[h3][b]New Bucket Feature - Depth Lever[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The bucket now has a lever for deciding what depth to travel to. 
[*] Deeper depths means more potential for loot but also danger… 
[*] Some environments are only found on certain depths.
[*] The further you get in the game, the deeper you will be able to travel.
[*] Currently there are 3 depths to explore, each containing a different set of maps.
[/list]
[h3][b]Maps and Environments[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Environment added - Caves
[*] New Environment added - Mines
[*] 7 New Maps added to the game for the players to explore!
[/list]
[h3][b]Items and Shop[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Item Type - Equipment
[*] New Mechanic - Armor. Armor absorbs incoming physical damage but will not save you from allies putting you on fire.
[*] New Equipment - Bucket Helmet
[*] New Equipment - Barrel Armor
[*] New Item Type - Instrument
[*] New Instrument - Horn Flute
[*] New Item - Dice
[*] New Item - Ward
[*] New sound for Bucket Drum
[*] Added support for items to restock when purchased in a shop. Currently used for torches.
[*] Cost and value of shop items rebalanced.
[*] New look for mushrooms. They want to look good too.
[/list]
[h3][b]Secret Rooms[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] …shhhh!
[/list]
[h3][b]New Hazards[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Hazard Type - Crusher Trap
[*] New Hazard Type - Swinging Axes
[*] New Hazard Type - Mushroom Spores
[*] New Hazard Type - Crazy Minecarts
[/list]
[h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Enemy Type - Slime
[*] New Enemy Type - Fire Fairies
[*] Enemy Health System - Enemies now have health, but that does not mean all of them can be defeated by mere goblins…
[*] Skeleton hunting speed has been reduced and their attack size is now consistent thanks to a bugfix.
[*] Crawlers now attempt to stay more relevant and make more noise…
[*] Gorers can now be defeated.
[*] Gorers now take longer to recover upon missing an attack.
[*] Knights now hold the grabbed player for longer, granting other players a bigger window of opportunity to free them.
[*] Lots of other various other tweaks to the existing enemies in pursuit of better balance in difficulty.
[*] Enemies are now less likely to linger around defeated goblins.
[*] Some enemies are now stunned for longer, depending on what item is thrown, but diminishing returns may apply…
[*] Enemy sound rebalancing and visual fixes.
[/list]
[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] A lit torch in your inventory will now illuminate your surroundings, even if it isn’t currently in your hand.
[*] Dousing a lit torch in water now refreshes their duration.
[*] Guards and shopkeepers in the lobby now respond to incoming items…
[*] Smaller groups of players no longer have to collect as much food as bigger groups to progress.
[*] Readjusted damage values of most traps, enemies and other hazards.
[*] Player Stamina depletes slower upon sprinting, which means you can run for longer!
[*] Difficulty now tied to Depth level chosen.
[*] Food is now worth more money. Maybe trade a steak for a torch?
[*] “Trips sign” added in the lobby to show your progress towards the next feeding sequence
[*] The food value of eating a goblin now more accurately reflects the amount of meat found on a scrawny goblin.
[*] Entrances and exits now emit a faint glow and some dust to make them easier to spot from a distance.
[*] More things found in the player surroundings, such as candles, can now be lit by torches
[*] Crosshair added to assist in aiming during the Throw action
[*] Chests now have a tiny chance to contain a mystery surprise :)
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Items no longer sometimes disappear from the container supposed to keep them safe. (It had one job…)
[*] Improved Networking and bug fixes for existing Traps
[*] You no longer get startled by one million sounds at the same time upon joining someone's lobby.
[*] Fixed many issues with items desyncing between players.
[*] The Gong/Dinner bell can no longer be rung twice, resulting in a quick defeat.
[*] Enemies now mask their fear signals to the player properly when they are being sneaky little rascals.
[*] Fixed issues where players would catch fire just by walking through another player that had a torch in their inventory. (It was fun seeing players blame one another but sadly we decided to fix it)
[*] Many issues with the bucket Map not working properly have been fixed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Speaking Stone would not work for players using Voice Activation.
[*] Improved Bucket Stability during higher latency.
[*] Feedback when putting items in the feeding plate or the selling plate are now displayed to all players properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where Skeleton attacks would attack further if facing certain directions.
[*] Fixed an issue where seeing in the dark sometimes wouldn't work in staircases.
[*] Video Tab in settings is no longer called “Audio”
[*] Audio Tab in settings is no longer called “Video”
[*] Fixed some issues where SFX and Music wouldn’t adhere to their respective sliders.
[*] Fixed an issue where items would be indestructible when thrown.
[*] So many bugfixes, like… who wrote this code in the first place, goblins? Haha. Anyways. There were a lot of bugs…
[*] Many more bugs added… probably.
[/list]

We hope you love all the new updates—we promise there's more to come soon! Gather your friends and get ready to dive into the chaos of the Pit. See you down there!

notes.title: 🔥 PATCH NOTES FROM THE PIT 🔥 PIT OF GOBLIN DEMO 0.1.2

notes.title: 🔥 PATCH NOTES FROM THE PIT 🔥 PIT OF GOBLIN DEMO 0.1.1
notes.content:
Oi, adventurers! The goblins here ‘ave cooked up some fiery fixes and tricks for yer next romp in our world. ‘Ere’s wot we’ve changed (or at least think we changed):

[list]
[*] [b]Fire Friendlier![/b] – Setting yer mates ablaze should be easier now... you know, for when they need a little "encouragement."
[*] [b]Buttons Be More Obvious [/b]– No more wonderin’ what does what – input hints are where they should be. Even the clumsiest goblin could figure it out.
[*] [b]Sensitivity Knob Twiddling [/b]– Mouse and controller sensitivity got a few adjustments. Yell at us if it still don’t feel right.
[*] [b]Less Annoyin’ Noises![/b] – Got rid of that sound repeat issue. Only the proper number of shrieks and squawks now.
[*][b] Sneakier Pathfindin’[/b] – We sent the AI goblins on a refresher course for getting around... mostly they learned something.
[*] [b]Fire Burn Time Tinkered [/b]– Made burning last just the right amount of time, so you’ll feel it... but not too much.
[*] [b]Less Network Yakkin’[/b] – Cut down on all that back and forth to keep things smoother than a goblin’s belly.
[*] [b]Can’t Hide Too Well[/b] – Don’t think crouching will get you out of sight so easily anymore. They’re onto yourr tricks!
[*] [b]Shiny New Goblin Eye Colors![/b] – We threw in a couple new eye hues for us goblins... purely cosmetic, but we’re feeling posh.
[*] [b]Weird Keyboards? [/b]– Got one of those strange layouts? We probably support it now. Goblins don’t judge.
[/list]

Now, get back in there and give it a whirl. And if you find anything that’s still busted, we’ll take a look (when we’re not napping, of course, jk devs don't sleep).

notes.title: DEMO is OUT
notes.content:
Hello there, 

We are very excited and equally nervous to let you know our first demo for Pit of Goblin will be available today as part of the Scream Fest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271762/92ebf009f391070ad9429c0e7a90e90bac6c78fe.png[/img]

We hope you have an absolute blast exploring this early taste of what’s to come! This demo is just a glimpse into the world we’re building, and we’re bursting with ideas on how to make it even better.

In our brand new demo you’ll get to:
[list]
[*] Explore 3 different locations
[*] Try to avoid 3 different enemies
[*] Feed an ever-hungry King
[*] Torches to light your way and a few other items in the shop
[*] Loot you’d have to discover
[*] Play online with up to 4 players and use voice chat but you can also explore on your own
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271762/cf5828448aafeed3540d3b0a5344ec51b786f966.png[/img]

We are eager to hear your feedback, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/vnqkpM4Gpb]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/FriendlyFoeDev]X [/url] or [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@friendlyfoedev]TikTok[/url] to be notified about with our upcoming content updates. 

Once again, thank you for playing and we’ll see you in The Pit!

D, J, K, K and M (the team at Friendly Foe)
